Join Sidecar Vending Services

We're a brand-new, locally owned vending company building something different in North Metro Atlanta — and we're always looking for the right people to grow with us.

Open Positions

Sales Professionals

We're always looking for qualified sales professionals to identify and build relationships with businesses across North Metro Atlanta — offices, warehouses, apartment communities, gyms, medical facilities, and auto dealerships that could benefit from a free vending machine partnership. If you're comfortable making introductions, building relationships, and closing new business, we want to hear from you.

We're also open to hearing from qualified candidates for future positions as Sidecar grows — even if you don't see a specific role listed here, feel free to reach out.
